name: Asakuchi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Asakuchi city emblem in green: a ring crossed by a stylised character of horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Asakuchi, a city in Okayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 21 March 2006.

features.role: Asakuchi city emblem — a ring crossed by a stylised character of horizontal strokes
